/audio/wikiwhy/kokoro-heart/wikiwhy-01-a.speechText: ascribing. Definition: Explaining something by assigning it a particular cause. In this passage, Morgan avoids ascribing the dog's failure to color-blindness.

/audio/wikiwhy/kokoro-heart/wikiwhy-01-l.speechText: luminosity. Definition: The brightness of something that gives off or reflects light. In this passage, luminosity means the brightness an animal perceives.

/audio/wikiwhy/kokoro-heart/wikiwhy-01-d.speechText: discriminate. Definition: To notice a difference and tell two things apart. In this passage, the mice do not readily discriminate between violet and red.

/audio/wikiwhy/kokoro-heart/wikiwhy-02-g.speechText: gait. Definition: A person's or animal's manner of walking. In this passage, the dog's stiff gait signals anger.

/audio/wikiwhy/kokoro-heart/wikiwhy-02-i.speechText: innervation. Definition: The activity of nerves that prepares or controls muscles. In this passage, innervation may prepare muscles for strong action.
inference. Definition: A conclusion reached from observations or reasoning. In this passage, Darwin labels his explanation an inference.

/audio/wikiwhy/kokoro-heart/wikiwhy-03-a.speechText: affectation. Definition: Behavior adopted mainly to impress other people. In this passage, using study mainly to impress others is affectation.

/audio/wikiwhy/kokoro-heart/wikiwhy-03-c.speechText: contemn. Definition: To regard something with scorn or contempt. In this passage, crafty people contemn, or scorn, studies.

/audio/wikiwhy/kokoro-heart/wikiwhy-03-m.speechText: marshalling. Definition: Arranging people, ideas, or affairs into an effective order. In this passage, marshalling means arranging affairs into an effective order.

/audio/wikiwhy/kokoro-heart/wikiwhy-05-a.speechText: abstractions. Definition: Ideas considered separately from concrete physical examples. In this passage, mathematical lines and planes are abstractions.

/audio/wikiwhy/kokoro-heart/wikiwhy-05-p.speechText: pensive. Definition: Deeply or quietly thoughtful. In this passage, Filby becomes pensive after a question.

/audio/wikiwhy/kokoro-heart/wikiwhy-05-i.speechText: infirmity. Definition: A weakness or limitation. In this passage, human infirmity makes the fourth dimension easy to overlook.

/audio/wikiwhy/kokoro-heart/wikiwhy-06-d.speechText: deduction. Definition: A conclusion reached by reasoning from available evidence. In this passage, Holmes explains his process of deduction.
distinction. Definition: A meaningful difference between two similar things. In this passage, Holmes draws a distinction between seeing and observing.

/audio/wikiwhy/kokoro-heart/wikiwhy-06-i.speechText: insensibly. Definition: Gradually or without noticing that it is happening. In this passage, theorizing too soon can insensibly twist the facts.

/audio/wikiwhy/kokoro-heart/wikiwhy-07-s.speechText: scow. Definition: A broad, flat-bottomed boat. In this passage, a scow is one of the boats Huck sees on the river.
speckled. Definition: Covered with small spots. In this passage, the sky is speckled with stars.

/audio/wikiwhy/kokoro-heart/wikiwhy-07-j.speechText: joggle. Definition: Shake with small, uneven movements. In this passage, the steamboat waves joggle the raft.

/audio/wikiwhy/kokoro-heart/wikiwhy-08-e.speechText: emigrant. Definition: A person who leaves one country to settle in another. In this passage, an emigrant ship carries families seeking a new home.

/audio/wikiwhy/kokoro-heart/wikiwhy-08-b.speechText: benevolent. Definition: Kind and intending to do good. In this passage, the owner watches with benevolent wishes for the travelers.

/audio/wikiwhy/kokoro-heart/wikiwhy-08-c.speechText: conviction. Definition: A firmly held belief or opinion. In this passage, the owner acquires a comfortable conviction that the ship is safe.

/audio/wikiwhy/kokoro-heart/wikiwhy-09-v.speechText: verdict. Definition: The official decision made by a jury in a court case. In this passage, the King asks the jury for a verdict before all the evidence is heard.

/audio/wikiwhy/kokoro-heart/wikiwhy-09-i.speechText: imitated. Definition: Copied the manner or appearance of someone or something. In this passage, the King claims the writer imitated someone else's handwriting.

/audio/wikiwhy/kokoro-heart/wikiwhy-09-a.speechText: atom. Definition: The smallest amount of something. In this passage, Alice says the letter does not contain an atom of meaning.

/audio/wikiwhy/kokoro-heart/wikiwhy-10-r.speechText: relators. Definition: People who tell or report an account. In this passage, credible relators make unfamiliar testimony easier to believe.

/audio/wikiwhy/kokoro-heart/wikiwhy-10-c.speechText: conformity. Definition: Agreement or correspondence between two things. In this passage, conformity with familiar experience makes the report easier to believe.

/audio/wikiwhy/kokoro-heart/wikiwhy-10-t.speechText: testimony. Definition: An account of what someone saw or knows. In this passage, testimony is the report someone gives about walking on ice.
